build_RandLSTM_model: build a RandLSTM model with configurable input_dim, output_dim, num_layers, and bidirectional settings
run_RandLSTM_forward: run the RandLSTM forward pass on a batch using embed, lstm, and pool operations
run_RandLSTM_lstm: run the lstm method on padded inputs with sequence lengths using pack_padded_sequence
run_RandLSTM_encode: run the encode method to get a numpy array representation of batch embeddings
review_RandLSTM_init: review the RandLSTM __init__ to understand parameter initialization and GPU setup
